turns.patient_opening: Hi. I’m 4 years old, and I’ve had a fever and a cough. I’ve also been coughing up blood, and my throat really hurts—my right tonsil, the back of my mouth/palate, and my pharynx feel painful, and I think my throat cartilage hurts too. I have some clear runny nose or nasal congestion, and I live with a lot of people and go to daycare.

turns.doctor_question: I’m sorry you’re dealing with this. **Do you have any pain somewhere that’s related to why you’re seeing a doctor today?**
turns.patient_answer: Yes. My throat really hurts and it feels sensitive. It’s mostly on the right side—right tonsil—and also the palate and pharynx feel painful. My pain is about 4 out of 10, and it feels like it’s in a more specific spot around 6 out of 10.

turns.doctor_question: What color is the rash (for example: red, pink, pale, dark, or yellow)? If there isn’t a rash, you can say “absent.”
turns.patient_answer: I don’t have a rash. Absent.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed that the tone of your voice has become deeper, softer, or hoarse?
turns.patient_answer: I think my voice sounds hoarse/sounds different, like it’s softer.

turns.doctor_question: Do you feel any pain somewhere in your body right now—specifically on the left side of your throat/tonsil area? (Yes or No)
turns.patient_answer: No. It’s mostly on the right side, not the left.

turns.doctor_question: Do you feel your pain as a **burning** sensation? (Yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: No. It doesn’t feel burning. It’s more like sore and sensitive pain.
